prompt: To make room for a fifth face on Mount Rushmore, one of the four current presidents has to come off. Pick which one and defend the removal.
response: Teddy Roosevelt comes off. Love the man, but he's the newcomer up there — the other three built the country and won the war that saved it. Somebody's gotta go and it sure ain't Washington, Jefferson, or Lincoln. Sorry, Teddy. Bull moose'll be just fine.
